shortDescription: Lists network objects for your organization.

options.name: access_key
options.description: The access key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_ACCESS_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the asset search. Each filter is a dictionary that includes 'type', 'operator', and 'value'. For agent filters use the list_agent_filters module or check https://developer.tenable.com/reference/io-filters-agents-list . For asset filters use the list_asset_filters module or check https://developer.tenable.com/reference/io-filters-assets-list . For asset filters with filtering capabilities check https://developer.tenable.com/reference/io-filters-assets-list-v2 . For c

options.name: include_deleted
options.description: Indicates whether to include deleted network objects in the response. Deleted network objects contain the additional attributes, deleted and deleted_by Which specifies the date (in Unix time) when the network object was deleted and the UUID of the user that deleted the network object.

options.name: limit
options.description: The number of records to retrieve. Default is 50, minimum is 1, and maximum is 5000.

options.name: offset
options.description: The starting record to retrieve. Default is 0.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_SECRET_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: sort
options.description: List of fields and order to sort the results. Specify fields and order separated by a colon (asc or desc).
